La Scuola International School
PYP Progress Report 2025-26 — Semester 2

Student: Abigail Chang
Grade: G3
Teacher: Ms. Canu

--- Learner Profile ---

Abigail demonstrates qualities of an Inquirer and Communicator. She asks
thoughtful questions during class discussions and shares her ideas clearly
with peers. She is developing as a Thinker, showing growing ability to
analyze and evaluate information.

--- CEFR Assessment ---

Listening: A2
Speaking: A1+
Reading: A2
Writing: A1

--- Approaches to Learning ---

Thinking skills: Accomplished
Communication skills: Accomplished
Self-management skills: Developing
Social skills: Accomplished
Research skills: Beginning

--- Subject Report: Italian ---

Abigail shows strong reading comprehension and can retell stories with key
details. She participates actively in discussions and uses vocabulary
appropriately. Her writing is developing — she can compose short paragraphs
but needs support with grammar and sentence structure.

Academic strengths: reading comprehension, oral participation, vocabulary use

--- Subject Report: English ---

Abigail reads at grade level and demonstrates strong inferential thinking.
She benefits from sentence starters for extended writing tasks. Her
collaborative group work is a consistent strength.

--- Social-Emotional Learning ---

Shows growing empathy when working with peers during group activities.
Takes turns and listens respectfully. Occasionally needs reminders to
stay on task during independent work time.

--- Attendance ---

Present: 92%
Absent: 8% (14 days)

--- Teacher Notes ---

Abigail is a curious and engaged learner. She finished early on several
occasions and could benefit from extension activities. She shows
self-discipline in managing her materials and following classroom routines.
Her emotional intelligence is evident in how she supports classmates who
are struggling with tasks.

--- Programme of Inquiry ---

Unit of Inquiry: How We Organize Ourselves
Central Idea: Systems work together to achieve a purpose
Abigail demonstrated Developing understanding of how systems are
interconnected and can be designed for specific purposes.
